name: Elopiprazole
summary: Elopiprazole is an experimental antipsychotic drug of the phenylpiperazine family which was under development for the treatment of psychotic disorders but was never marketed. pharmacology.text: The drug acts as a dual dopamine D2 and D3 receptor antagonist and serotonin 5-HT1A receptor agonist (Ki = 0.45 nM, 1.29 nM, and 1.45 nM, respectively).

uses.text: Elopiprazole (INN; developmental code names DU-29840 and DU-29894) is an experimental antipsychotic drug of the phenylpiperazine family which was under development for the treatment of psychotic disorders but was never marketed. Elopiprazole was under development by Solvay Duphar. It reached phase 1 clinical trials for psychotic disorders prior to the discontinuation of its development.
